splash.hero: Your AI Agent programming assistant. Combining WishfulClaw's toolchain, KodaClaw's memory and personality system, and OpenClaw's active recall mechanism.

features.localFirstDesc: Agents can work with files, terminals, projects, memory, and workspace context on your machine.
features.extensibleDesc: Create focused assistants, delegate tasks, and keep a human-in-the-loop workflow.
features.intelligentDesc: Choose a SOUL.md persona so every conversation starts from the right collaboration style.

personaSelect.title: Choose Your Companion
personaSelect.subtitle: Different companions have different personalities and communication styles. You can switch anytime.
personaSelect.hint: You can modify or create new personas in Settings anytime

welcome.title: Welcome to Wishful Claw
welcome.subtitle: More than an AI assistant — it's your programming partner. Your data stays local, privacy by design. Combines a powerful toolchain with customizable personas, so every conversation has personality. Tools at your fingertips, models in the cloud, efficiency by your side.
